Brief for week of 2026-08-24. Product: BXA.
## Bottom line
Projected national BXA TRx is 4,105 for the week of 2026-08-24.
Like for like on 8 of 8 territories, BXA TRx is down 3.7% against the weeks from 2026-07-13 to 2026-08-17.
BXA held 30% of the four-brand market basket.
Least sure: the Southeast change (down 18%); its confidence, Medium, is the lowest of this brief's stories.
Before Metacora launched, BXA held 35% of the four-brand basket.
## The numbers
Scope: week of 2026-08-24, compared with the weeks from 2026-07-13 to 2026-08-17.
Like for like, BXA TRx averaged 4,105 a week across 8 of 8 territories, down 3.7% against the comparison weeks.
Week over week, BXA TRx is 4,105 against 4,349 the week before (down 5.6%).
Against the comparison weeks, Southeast fell most (down 18%) and Pacific rose most (up 3.7%).
Chart: BXA TRx a week, 2026-06-01 to 2026-08-24: projected national. Hollow points are projected or estimated, an assumption (weeks of 2026-07-06). No forecast is drawn.
Projected national moved from 4,269 in the week of 2026-06-01 to 4,105 in the week of 2026-08-24.
By territory, all observed.
Great Lakes: 556 BXA TRx a week; down 12% on the week before; down 13% on the comparison weeks.
Mid-Atlantic: 671 BXA TRx a week; down 2.9% on the week before; up 1.2% on the comparison weeks.
Mountain: 346 BXA TRx a week; up 8.5% on the week before; down 1.9% on the comparison weeks.
New England: 372 BXA TRx a week; down 4.9% on the week before; up 0.6% on the comparison weeks.
Northwest: 362 BXA TRx a week; down 13% on the week before; down 4.3% on the comparison weeks.
Pacific: 712 BXA TRx a week; down 1.5% on the week before; up 3.7% on the comparison weeks.
South Central: 617 BXA TRx a week; down 1.6% on the week before; up 2.3% on the comparison weeks.
Southeast: 469 BXA TRx a week; down 14% on the week before; down 18% on the comparison weeks.
## What changed and why
Southeast (continuing since 2026-08-03): BXA TRx averaged 469 a week in these weeks against 639 in the four weeks before the rep coverage lapse began (down 27%).
Promotion: supported, as an association. Rep coverage lapsed on 2026-08-03: aggregated rep calls averaged 19 a week from then, against 55 in the four weeks before (66% lower).
Confidence: Medium. Candidate drivers: promotion.
Also checked, in this order:
- Data artifact: ruled out. Every Southeast cut in these weeks passes the feed gate.
- Access: ruled out. No BXA access change in the Southeast plans in the tested months.
- Supply: ruled out. No tested lag lines up with TRx. BXA inventory fill averaged 0.97.
- Competitor launch: ruled out as a local cause. Before the change Metacora held 14% of the basket here against 13% elsewhere.
The event began before the comparison weeks, so the change is set against the four weeks before 2026-08-03.
Story one: competitor Metacora (launched 2026-03-02). This is a continuing story, week 25 since launch, share up on the comparison weeks. Metacora held 16% of the four-brand basket and BXA held 30%, against 35% for BXA in the four weeks before launch. Confidence: Medium. The share loss is measured; its effect on volume is not separated from other drivers.
Chart: Shares of the four-brand basket, 2026-06-01 to 2026-08-24, every reportable territory.
Metacora held 16% of the basket in the week of 2026-08-24.
Considered and dropped: 8 territories moved within their normal range.
## What the data can't tell us
Data health: 8 of 8 territories pass the feed gate for 2026-08-24. No cut is withheld.
Chart: Feed coverage by territory and week, 2026-06-01 to 2026-08-24. Crossed cells are estimated, an assumption.
1 territory-week in this window is not an observed count.
## Next checks
- Southeast: confirm the promotion finding. Owner: sales leadership and marketing. Unlocks: whether to change call plans or campaign timing in the territory.
- Metacora: track the basket shares each week. Owner: marketing and sales. Unlocks: whether to adjust the response to Metacora.
## Appendix
Data version 47bcfd650564. Product: BXA (Cardiovela), synthetic data.
Assumptions:
- Comparison weeks: the weeks from 2026-07-13 to 2026-08-17. Source: analyst's choice.
- Like for like: changes use only territories whose feed passed the gate in every week compared. Withheld cuts are left out of every change and story, and never read as zero demand. Holiday weeks are left out. Source: the feed gate.
- Drivers: the checks evaluate the same week and delays of one and two weeks. A supported timing requires activity to move with reportable TRx. Monthly access data cannot identify a weekly lag. Promotion: controls first, then comparable territories.
Method: like-for-like figures use only territories whose feed passed the gate in every week compared. The projected national divides each territory's observed TRx by its panel coverage, and estimates a territory that cannot be read from its recent share of national. Changes, stories and drivers use like-for-like cuts only.
Glossary:
- Like for like: a comparison that uses only territories whose feed passed its checks in every week compared.
- Projected national: national TRx built territory by territory, each territory's observed TRx divided by its panel coverage, summed.
- Withheld cut: a territory or week whose data failed its checks, so no story or driver is given for it.

CMP-3.question: Week of 2026-08-24: What changed this week?

P1-Q1.answer:
Brief for week of 2026-07-06. Product: BXA.
## Bottom line
Data warning: Great Lakes' feed for 2026-07-06 failed its checks, so its TRx is estimated from its recent share of national, an assumption. No story is given for it.
Projected national BXA TRx is 4,285 for the week of 2026-07-06.
Like for like on 7 of 8 territories, BXA TRx is up 7.6% against the four weeks before (2026-06-08 to 2026-06-29).
BXA held 32% of the four-brand market basket.
Least sure: Great Lakes' TRx of 620 is an assumption, estimated from its recent share of national, because its feed failed its checks.
Before Metacora launched, BXA held 35% of the four-brand basket.
## The numbers
Scope: week of 2026-07-06, compared with the four weeks before (2026-06-08 to 2026-06-29). Levels marked projected or estimated are assumptions.
Like for like, BXA TRx averaged 3,665 a week across 7 of 8 territories, up 7.6% against the comparison weeks.
Week over week, BXA TRx is 3,665 against 3,994 the week before (down 8.2%).
On the 7 territories that report both weeks, BXA TRx went from 3,381 to 3,665 (up 8.4%).
Against the comparison weeks, South Central fell most (down 8.4%) and Pacific rose most (up 56%).
The headline total of reportable cuts is down 8.0%, but that move comes mostly from withheld cuts, so it is a data artifact, not a business change.
Chart: BXA TRx a week, 2026-04-13 to 2026-07-06: projected national. Hollow points are projected or estimated, an assumption (weeks of 2026-05-04, 2026-07-06). No forecast is drawn.
Projected national moved from 4,653 in the week of 2026-04-13 to 4,285 in the week of 2026-07-06.
By territory, observed unless marked; a projected or estimated level is an assumption, not an observed count.
Great Lakes: 620 BXA TRx a week (estimated, an assumption: its share of national in the four clean weeks before; its feed failed the gate); no change is given, because a week compared failed the feed gate.
Mid-Atlantic: 683 BXA TRx a week; down 4.1% on the week before; up 3.4% on the comparison weeks.
Mountain: 317 BXA TRx a week; up 13% on the week before; down 0.5% on the comparison weeks.
New England: 423 BXA TRx a week; up 42% on the week before; up 11% on the comparison weeks.
Northwest: 394 BXA TRx a week; down 4.6% on the week before; up 4.4% on the comparison weeks.
Pacific: 699 BXA TRx a week; up 45% on the week before; up 56% on the comparison weeks.
South Central: 535 BXA TRx a week; down 6.0% on the week before; down 8.4% on the comparison weeks.
Southeast: 614 BXA TRx a week; down 1.9% on the week before; down 3.5% on the comparison weeks.
## What changed and why
Story one: Pacific. BXA TRx averaged 699 a week against 449 before (up 56%), while the other territories were flat 0.3%.
By channel: Medicaid up 75%, Commercial up 61%, Cash too small to quote; by specialty: Internal medicine up 76%, Primary care up 63%.
Checked, in this order:
- Data artifact: ruled out. Every Pacific cut in these weeks passes the feed gate.
- Access: ruled out. No BXA access change in the Pacific plans in the tested months.
- Promotion: ruled out. No tested lag lines up with TRx. New patients (NBRx) in Pacific rose 67% and TRx rose 56% on the comparison weeks. Aggregated calls averaged 52 a week against 57 in the comparison weeks, each shifted two weeks earlier. Samples moved, and TRx did not follow. Re-check after 2026-08-03.
- Supply: ruled out. No tested lag lines up with TRx. BXA inventory fill averaged 1.00.
- Competitor launch: ruled out as a local cause. Before the change Metacora held 11% of the basket here against 10% elsewhere.
Confidence: Low. Unresolved, investigate next. No driver is named.

In the week of 2026-07-06, Pacific had 699 BXA TRx, above its baseline band.
Cuts of the change by plan, weekly TRx. Total: up 251 TRx a week.
- Commercial plan one: up 64 TRx a week.
- Medicare Part D plan one: up 42 TRx a week.

Data version 47bcfd650564. Product: BXA (Cardiovela), synthetic data.
Assumptions:
- Comparison weeks: the four weeks before (2026-06-08 to 2026-06-29). Source: the brief's default rule.
- Like for like: changes use only territories whose feed passed the gate in every week compared. Withheld cuts are left out of every change and story, and never read as zero demand. Holiday weeks are left out. Source: the feed gate.
- Not observed: Great Lakes is projected or estimated, not counted. Source: panel coverage and each territory's recent share of national.
- Drivers: the checks evaluate the same week and delays of one and two weeks. A supported timing requires activity to move with reportable TRx. Monthly access data cannot identify a weekly lag. Promotion: controls first, then comparable territories. Metacora's local share: 2026-04-06 to 2026-06-29.
Method: like-for-like figures use only territories whose feed passed the gate in every week compared. The projected national divides each territory's observed TRx by its panel coverage, and estimates a territory that cannot be read from its recent share of national. Changes, stories and drivers use like-for-like cuts only.
Glossary:
- Like for like: a comparison that uses only territories whose feed passed its checks in every week compared.
- Panel coverage: the share of a territory's expected prescription records that arrived in a given week.
- Projected national: national TRx built territory by territory, each territory's observed TRx divided by its panel coverage, summed.
- Estimated territory: a territory whose coverage is too low to project, or whose count failed its checks, filled from its own recent share of national and labelled as estimated, an assumption.
- Withheld cut: a territory or week whose data failed its checks, so no story or driver is given for it.

                coalesce(sum(trx) filter (where week_start in (DATE '2026-07-06')), 0) / 1.0 as recent,
                coalesce(sum(trx) filter (where week_start in (DATE '2026-06-08',DATE '2026-06-15',DATE '2026-06-22',DATE '2026-06-29')), 0) / 4.0 as baseline
            from reporting.v_reportable_rx
            where product_id = 'BXA' and territory_id = 'PACIFIC'
                and week_start in (DATE '2026-06-08',DATE '2026-06-15',DATE '2026-06-22',DATE '2026-06-29',DATE '2026-07-06')
            group by 1
        ), ordered as (
            select *, recent - baseline as delta,
                row_number() over (order by abs(recent - baseline) desc, cut) as rank
            from cuts
        ), running as (
            select *, round(sum(delta) over (order by rank), 2) as cumulative
            from ordered
        ), contributions as (
            select *, cumulative - lag(cumulative, 1, 0) over (order by rank) as contribution
            from running
        )

P1-Q4.answer:
Brief for weeks 2025-08-04 to 2025-10-27. Product: BXA.
## Bottom line
Projected national BXA TRx averaged 4,999 a week from 2025-08-04 to 2025-10-27.
Like for like on 8 of 8 territories, BXA TRx is up 11% against the four weeks before (2025-07-07 to 2025-07-28).
BXA held 36% of the four-brand market basket.
Least sure: the Mid-Atlantic change (up 9.9%); its confidence, High, is the lowest of this brief's stories.
## The numbers
Scope: weeks 2025-08-04 to 2025-10-27, compared with the four weeks before (2025-07-07 to 2025-07-28).
Like for like, BXA TRx averaged 4,999 a week across 8 of 8 territories, up 11% against the comparison weeks.
Against the comparison weeks, Pacific rose most (up 16%).
Chart: BXA TRx a week, 2025-08-04 to 2025-10-27: projected national. No forecast is drawn.
Projected national moved from 4,573 in the week of 2025-08-04 to 5,180 in the week of 2025-10-27.
By territory, all observed.
Great Lakes: 724 BXA TRx a week; up 5.6% on the comparison weeks.
Mid-Atlantic: 712 BXA TRx a week; up 9.9% on the comparison weeks.
Mountain: 391 BXA TRx a week; up 9.9% on the comparison weeks.
New England: 441 BXA TRx a week; up 14% on the comparison weeks.
Northwest: 448 BXA TRx a week; up 14% on the comparison weeks.
Pacific: 843 BXA TRx a week; up 16% on the comparison weeks.
South Central: 661 BXA TRx a week; up 6.9% on the comparison weeks.
Southeast: 780 BXA TRx a week; up 13% on the comparison weeks.
## What changed and why
Story one: Mid-Atlantic. BXA TRx averaged 712 a week against 648 before (up 9.9%), while the other territories were up 11%.
By channel: Commercial up 17%, Medicaid up 15%; by specialty: Cardiology up 33%, Endocrinology up 9.0%.
Checked, in this order:
- Data artifact: ruled out. Every Mid-Atlantic cut in these weeks passes the feed gate.
- Access: supported. The Medicare Part D plan one (26% of the territory's covered lives) added restrictions (tier, prior authorization or step therapy) effective 2025-08-01. BXA volume on that plan fell 8.0%. The monthly source cannot distinguish a weekly lag.
- Promotion: not testable; activity held level, so its effect cannot be measured this period. All four channels stayed near their comparison-week levels at every tested lag. Re-check after 2025-11-24.
- Supply: ruled out. No tested lag lines up with TRx. BXA inventory fill averaged 0.98.
- Competitor launch: ruled out. Metacora did not launch until 2026-03-02.
Confidence: High. Leading driver: access.
Chart: Mid-Atlantic BXA TRx a week, 2025-08-04 to 2025-10-27, against the band of its baseline weeks (595 to 696). Second panel: BXA TRx on the plan whose access changed, the driver the checks support.

- Commercial: up 40 TRx a week.
- Medicaid: up 19 TRx a week.
- Cash: up 6 TRx a week (small cell: noisy).
- Medicare Part D: flat 0 TRx a week.
Promotion detail, read at the same week (the period against the comparison weeks, aggregated activity, weekly averages):
- New patients (NBRx): 82.5 to 95.3 (up 16%).
- TRx: 648 to 712 (up 9.9%).
- Rep calls: 52 to 50 (down 2.8%).
- Digital impressions: 1,882 to 1,829 (down 2.8%).
- Samples: 39 to 39 (down 0.8%).
- Speaker programs: 0.8 to 1.3 (up 78%).
- Lags tested: same week, one-week lag and two-week lag. A fuller read is possible after 2025-11-24.
Medicare Part D plan one in Mid-Atlantic: BXA TRx averaged 145 a week on the comparison weeks against 158 before (down 8.0%).
Confidence: High. Leading driver: access.
Checked for this plan, in this order:
- Data artifact: ruled out. Every Mid-Atlantic cut in these weeks passes the feed gate.
- Access: supported. The Medicare Part D plan one (26% of the territory's covered lives) added restrictions (tier, prior authorization or step therapy) effective 2025-08-01. BXA volume on that plan fell 8.0%. The monthly source cannot distinguish a weekly lag.
- Promotion: not testable; activity held level, so its effect cannot be measured this period. All four channels stayed near their comparison-week levels at every tested lag. Re-check after 2025-11-24.
- Supply: ruled out. No tested lag lines up with TRx. BXA inventory fill averaged 0.98.
- Competitor launch: ruled out. Metacora did not launch until 2026-03-02.
Data, promotion, supply and competitor have no plan-level test, so they carry the Mid-Atlantic verdicts.
National BXA TRx rose 11% on the comparison weeks.
Considered and dropped: 7 territories moved within their normal range.
## What the data can't tell us
Data health: 0 territory-weeks are withheld across these weeks. No cut is withheld.
Calendar weeks in this period are left out of the stories below, because lower volume there is expected.
Chart: Feed coverage by territory and week, 2025-08-04 to 2025-10-27. Every cell is an observed count.
Every territory-week in this window is an observed count.
## Next checks
- Mid-Atlantic: confirm the access finding. Owner: market access. Unlocks: whether the plan's coverage change needs a pull-through response.
## Appendix
Data version 47bcfd650564. Product: BXA (Cardiovela), synthetic data.
Assumptions:
- Comparison weeks: the four weeks before (2025-07-07 to 2025-07-28). Source: the brief's default rule. Material-change screen: 2025-05-05 to 2025-07-28.
- Like for like: changes use only territories whose feed passed the gate in every week compared. Withheld cuts are left out of every change and story, and never read as zero demand. Calendar weeks are left out of the stories. Source: the feed gate.
- Drivers: the checks evaluate the same week and delays of one and two weeks. A supported timing requires activity to move with reportable TRx. Monthly access data cannot identify a weekly lag. Promotion: controls first, then comparable territories.
Method: like-for-like figures use only territories whose feed passed the gate in every week compared. The projected national divides each territory's observed TRx by its panel coverage, and estimates a territory that cannot be read from its recent share of national. Changes, stories and drivers use like-for-like cuts only.
Glossary:
- Like for like: a comparison that uses only territories whose feed passed its checks in every week compared.
- Projected national: national TRx built territory by territory, each territory's observed TRx divided by its panel coverage, summed.
- Withheld cut: a territory or week whose data failed its checks, so no story or driver is given for it.

P1-Q4.question: Weeks of 2025-08-04 to 2025-10-27: Where did this number come from?

P2-Q2.answer:
Brief for weeks 2025-08-04 to 2025-10-27. Product: BXA.
## Bottom line
Mid-Atlantic: BXA TRx is up 9.9% against the four weeks before (2025-07-07 to 2025-07-28).
Projected national BXA TRx averaged 4,999 a week from 2025-08-04 to 2025-10-27.
Like for like on 8 of 8 territories, BXA TRx is up 11% against the four weeks before (2025-07-07 to 2025-07-28).
BXA held 36% of the four-brand market basket.
Least sure: the Mid-Atlantic change (up 9.9%), within its normal range; reported because the question asks about it.
## The numbers
Scope: weeks 2025-08-04 to 2025-10-27, compared with the four weeks before (2025-07-07 to 2025-07-28).
Like for like, BXA TRx averaged 4,999 a week across 8 of 8 territories, up 11% against the comparison weeks.
Against the comparison weeks, Pacific rose most (up 16%).
Chart: BXA TRx a week, 2025-08-04 to 2025-10-27: projected national and Mid-Atlantic. No forecast is drawn.
Projected national moved from 4,573 in the week of 2025-08-04 to 5,180 in the week of 2025-10-27.
By territory, all observed.
Great Lakes: 724 BXA TRx a week; up 5.6% on the comparison weeks.
Mid-Atlantic: 712 BXA TRx a week; up 9.9% on the comparison weeks.
Mountain: 391 BXA TRx a week; up 9.9% on the comparison weeks.
New England: 441 BXA TRx a week; up 14% on the comparison weeks.
Northwest: 448 BXA TRx a week; up 14% on the comparison weeks.
Pacific: 843 BXA TRx a week; up 16% on the comparison weeks.
South Central: 661 BXA TRx a week; up 6.9% on the comparison weeks.
Southeast: 780 BXA TRx a week; up 13% on the comparison weeks.
## What changed and why
Story one: Mid-Atlantic. BXA TRx averaged 712 a week against 648 before (up 9.9%), while the other territories were up 11%. Mid-Atlantic moved within its normal range; it is reported because the question asks about it.
By channel: Commercial up 17%, Medicaid up 15%; by specialty: Cardiology up 33%, Endocrinology up 9.0%.
Checked, in this order:
- Data artifact: ruled out. Every Mid-Atlantic cut in these weeks passes the feed gate.
- Access: supported. The Medicare Part D plan one (26% of the territory's covered lives) added restrictions (tier, prior authorization or step therapy) effective 2025-08-01. BXA volume on that plan fell 8.0%. The monthly source cannot distinguish a weekly lag.
- Promotion: not testable; activity held level, so its effect cannot be measured this period. All four channels stayed near their comparison-week levels at every tested lag. Re-check after 2025-11-24.
- Supply: ruled out. No tested lag lines up with TRx. BXA inventory fill averaged 0.98.
- Competitor launch: ruled out. Metacora did not launch until 2026-03-02.
Confidence: High. Leading driver: access.
Chart: Mid-Atlantic BXA TRx a week, 2025-08-04 to 2025-10-27, against the band of its baseline weeks (595 to 696). Second panel: BXA TRx on the plan whose access changed, the driver the checks support.
In the week of 2025-10-27, Mid-Atlantic had 826 BXA TRx, above its baseline band.

- Commercial plan two: up 23 TRx a week.

- Cardiology: up 43 TRx a week.
- Primary care: up 16 TRx a week.
- Endocrinology: up 7 TRx a week.
- Internal medicine: down 1 TRx a week.
Cuts of the change by channel, weekly TRx. Total: up 64 TRx a week.
- Commercial: up 40 TRx a week.
- Medicaid: up 19 TRx a week.
- Cash: up 6 TRx a week (small cell: noisy).
- Medicare Part D: flat 0 TRx a week.
Promotion detail, read at the same week (the period against the comparison weeks, aggregated activity, weekly averages):
- New patients (NBRx): 82.5 to 95.3 (up 16%).
- TRx: 648 to 712 (up 9.9%).
- Rep calls: 52 to 50 (down 2.8%).
- Digital impressions: 1,882 to 1,829 (down 2.8%).
- Samples: 39 to 39 (down 0.8%).
- Speaker programs: 0.8 to 1.3 (up 78%).
- Lags tested: same week, one-week lag and two-week lag. A fuller read is possible after 2025-11-24.
Medicare Part D plan one in Mid-Atlantic: BXA TRx averaged 145 a week on the comparison weeks against 158 before (down 8.0%).
Confidence: High. Leading driver: access.
Checked for this plan, in this order:
- Data artifact: ruled out. Every Mid-Atlantic cut in these weeks passes the feed gate.
- Access: supported. The Medicare Part D plan one (26% of the territory's covered lives) added restrictions (tier, prior authorization or step therapy) effective 2025-08-01. BXA volume on that plan fell 8.0%. The monthly source cannot distinguish a weekly lag.
- Promotion: not testable; activity held level, so its effect cannot be measured this period. All four channels stayed near their comparison-week levels at every tested lag. Re-check after 2025-11-24.
- Supply: ruled out. No tested lag lines up with TRx. BXA inventory fill averaged 0.98.
- Competitor launch: ruled out. Metacora did not launch until 2026-03-02.
Data, promotion, supply and competitor have no plan-level test, so they carry the Mid-Atlantic verdicts.
National BXA TRx rose 11% on the comparison weeks.
Considered and dropped: 7 territories moved within their normal range.
## What the data can't tell us
Data health: 0 territory-weeks are withheld across these weeks. No cut is withheld.
Calendar weeks in this period are left out of the stories below, because lower volume there is expected.
Chart: Feed coverage by territory and week, 2025-08-04 to 2025-10-27. Every cell is an observed count.
Every territory-week in this window is an observed count.
Feed for Mid-Atlantic in these weeks: 1,664 rows received against 1,664 expected; lowest panel coverage 1.000.
## Next checks
- Mid-Atlantic: confirm the access finding. Owner: market access. Unlocks: whether the plan's coverage change needs a pull-through response.
## Appendix
Data version 47bcfd650564. Product: BXA (Cardiovela), synthetic data.
Assumptions:
- Comparison weeks: the four weeks before (2025-07-07 to 2025-07-28). Source: the brief's default rule. Material-change screen: 2025-05-05 to 2025-07-28.
- Like for like: changes use only territories whose feed passed the gate in every week compared. Withheld cuts are left out of every change and story, and never read as zero demand. Calendar weeks are left out of the stories. Source: the feed gate.
- Drivers: the checks evaluate the same week and delays of one and two weeks. A supported timing requires activity to move with reportable TRx. Monthly access data cannot identify a weekly lag. Promotion: controls first, then comparable territories.
Method: like-for-like figures use only territories whose feed passed the gate in every week compared. The projected national divides each territory's observed TRx by its panel coverage, and estimates a territory that cannot be read from its recent share of national. Changes, stories and drivers use like-for-like cuts only.
Glossary:
- Like for like: a comparison that uses only territories whose feed passed its checks in every week compared.
- Panel coverage: the share of a territory's expected prescription records that arrived in a given week.
- Projected national: national TRx built territory by territory, each territory's observed TRx divided by its panel coverage, summed.
- Withheld cut: a territory or week whose data failed its checks, so no story or driver is given for it.

P2-Q2.question: Weeks of 2025-08-04 to 2025-10-27, Mid-Atlantic: What explanations were considered, and why were the others ruled out?

P2-Q3.answer:
Brief for weeks 2026-08-31 to 2026-09-28. Product: BXA.
## Bottom line
South Central: BXA TRx is down 4.4% against the four weeks before (2026-08-03 to 2026-08-24).
Projected national BXA TRx averaged 4,604 a week from 2026-08-31 to 2026-09-28.
Like for like on 8 of 8 territories, BXA TRx is up 9.7% against the four weeks before (2026-08-03 to 2026-08-24).
BXA held 31% of the four-brand market basket.
Least sure: the South Central change (down 4.4%), within its normal range; reported because the question asks about it.
Before Metacora launched, BXA held 35% of the four-brand basket.
## The numbers
Scope: weeks 2026-08-31 to 2026-09-28, compared with the four weeks before (2026-08-03 to 2026-08-24).
Like for like, BXA TRx averaged 4,604 a week across 8 of 8 territories, up 9.7% against the comparison weeks.
Against the comparison weeks, South Central fell most (down 4.4%) and Southeast rose most (up 32%).
Chart: BXA TRx a week, 2026-07-06 to 2026-09-28: projected national and South Central. Hollow points are projected or estimated, an assumption (weeks of 2026-07-06). No forecast is drawn.
Projected national moved from 4,285 in the week of 2026-07-06 to 4,808 in the week of 2026-09-28.
By territory, all observed.
Great Lakes: 692 BXA TRx a week; up 14% on the comparison weeks.
Mid-Atlantic: 719 BXA TRx a week; up 4.7% on the comparison weeks.
Mountain: 393 BXA TRx a week; up 13% on the comparison weeks.
New England: 411 BXA TRx a week; up 8.4% on the comparison weeks.
Northwest: 420 BXA TRx a week; up 9.4% on the comparison weeks.
Pacific: 751 BXA TRx a week; up 7.1% on the comparison weeks.
South Central: 575 BXA TRx a week; down 4.4% on the comparison weeks.
Southeast: 644 BXA TRx a week; up 32% on the comparison weeks.
## What changed and why
Story one: Southeast. BXA TRx averaged 644 a week against 488 before (up 32%), while the other territories were up 6.8%.
By channel: Medicaid up 34%, Commercial up 32%, Cash too small to quote; by specialty: Endocrinology up 40%, Primary care up 37%.
Checked, in this order:
- Data artifact: ruled out. Every Southeast cut in these weeks passes the feed gate.
- Access: ruled out. No BXA access change in the Southeast plans in the tested months.
- Promotion: supported as recovery after the promotion lapse of 2026-08-03 to 2026-08-31, same week. New patients (NBRx) in Southeast rose 52% and TRx rose 32% on the comparison weeks. Aggregated calls averaged 43 a week against 19 in the comparison weeks, which include lapse weeks (128% higher). Compared with territories without a promotion change, this implies 89 to 177 extra TRx a week. Re-check after 2026-10-26.
- Supply: ruled out. No tested lag lines up with TRx. BXA inventory fill averaged 0.99.
- Competitor launch: ruled out as a local cause. Before the change Metacora held 14% of the basket here against 14% elsewhere.
Confidence: Medium. Candidate drivers: promotion.
Chart: Southeast BXA TRx a week, 2026-07-06 to 2026-09-28, against the band of its baseline weeks (437 to 546). Second panel: Aggregated rep calls a week, the driver the checks support.
In the week of 2026-09-28, Southeast had 799 BXA TRx, above its baseline band.

Method: like-for-like figures use only territories whose feed passed the gate in every week compared. Glossary:
- Like for like: a comparison that uses only territories whose feed passed its checks in every week compared.
- Panel coverage: the share of a territory's expected prescription records that arrived in a given week.

P2-Q3.question: Weeks of 2026-08-31 to 2026-09-28, South Central: How confident are we, and where should we say we don't know yet?

P3-Q1.answer:
Brief for week of 2026-04-27. Product: BXA.
## Bottom line
Projected national BXA TRx is 4,590 for the week of 2026-04-27.
Like for like on 7 of 8 territories, BXA TRx is flat 0.5% against the four weeks before (2026-03-30 to 2026-04-20).
BXA held 33% of the four-brand market basket.
Least sure: the week-over-week change (down 2.9%), because it compares one week with one week.
Before Metacora launched, BXA held 35% of the four-brand basket.
## The numbers
Scope: week of 2026-04-27, compared with the four weeks before (2026-03-30 to 2026-04-20).
Like for like, BXA TRx averaged 3,946 a week across 7 of 8 territories, flat 0.5% against the comparison weeks.
Week over week, BXA TRx is 4,590 against 4,728 the week before (down 2.9%).
Against the comparison weeks, Pacific fell most (down 12%) and Northwest rose most (up 22%).
Chart: BXA TRx a week, 2026-02-02 to 2026-04-27: projected national. Hollow points are projected or estimated, an assumption (weeks of 2026-04-06). No forecast is drawn.
Projected national moved from 4,835 in the week of 2026-02-02 to 4,590 in the week of 2026-04-27.
By territory, all observed.
Great Lakes: 657 BXA TRx a week; down 3.0% on the week before; up 8.2% on the comparison weeks.
Mid-Atlantic: 644 BXA TRx a week; no change is given, because a week compared failed the feed gate.
Mountain: 335 BXA TRx a week; down 3.2% on the week before; down 4.1% on the comparison weeks.
New England: 397 BXA TRx a week; down 1.2% on the week before; down 2.2% on the comparison weeks.
Northwest: 497 BXA TRx a week; up 23% on the week before; up 22% on the comparison weeks.
Pacific: 706 BXA TRx a week; down 17% on the week before; down 12% on the comparison weeks.
South Central: 616 BXA TRx a week; down 6.0% on the week before; down 5.5% on the comparison weeks.
Southeast: 738 BXA TRx a week; up 9.8% on the week before; flat 0.3% on the comparison weeks.
## What changed and why
Story one: competitor Metacora (launched 2026-03-02). This is a continuing story, week 8 since launch, share up on the comparison weeks. Metacora held 9.3% of the four-brand basket and BXA held 33%, against 35% for BXA in the four weeks before launch. Confidence: Medium. The share loss is measured; its effect on volume is not separated from other drivers.
Chart: Shares of the four-brand basket, 2026-02-02 to 2026-04-27, every reportable territory.
Metacora held 9.3% of the basket in the week of 2026-04-27.
Considered and dropped: 7 territories moved within their normal range.
## What the data can't tell us
Data health: 8 of 8 territories pass the feed gate for 2026-04-27. No cut is withheld.
Chart: Feed coverage by territory and week, 2026-02-02 to 2026-04-27. Crossed cells are estimated, an assumption.
1 territory-week in this window is not an observed count.
## Next checks
- Metacora: track the basket shares each week. Owner: marketing and sales. Unlocks: whether to adjust the response to Metacora.
## Appendix
Data version 47bcfd650564. Product: BXA (Cardiovela), synthetic data.
Assumptions:
- Comparison weeks: the four weeks before (2026-03-30 to 2026-04-20). Source: the brief's default rule.
- Like for like: changes use only territories whose feed passed the gate in every week compared. Withheld cuts are left out of every change and story, and never read as zero demand. Holiday weeks are left out. Source: the feed gate.
- Drivers: the checks evaluate the same week and delays of one and two weeks. A supported timing requires activity to move with reportable TRx. Monthly access data cannot identify a weekly lag. Promotion: controls first, then comparable territories. Metacora's local share: 2026-03-02 to 2026-04-20.
Method: like-for-like figures use only territories whose feed passed the gate in every week compared. The projected national divides each territory's observed TRx by its panel coverage, and estimates a territory that cannot be read from its recent share of national. Changes, stories and drivers use like-for-like cuts only.
Glossary:
- Like for like: a comparison that uses only territories whose feed passed its checks in every week compared.
- Projected national: national TRx built territory by territory, each territory's observed TRx divided by its panel coverage, summed.
- Withheld cut: a territory or week whose data failed its checks, so no story or driver is given for it.

P3-Q1.question: Week of 2026-04-27: What changed this week that I need to know about?

P3-Q4.answer:
Brief for week of 2026-09-28. Product: BXA.
## Bottom line
Projected national BXA TRx is 4,808 for the week of 2026-09-28.
Like for like on 8 of 8 territories, BXA TRx is up 8.4% against the four weeks before (2026-08-31 to 2026-09-21).
BXA held 32% of the four-brand market basket.
Least sure: the New England change (up 27%); its confidence, Low, is the lowest of this brief's stories.
Before Metacora launched, BXA held 35% of the four-brand basket.
## The numbers
Scope: week of 2026-09-28, compared with the four weeks before (2026-08-31 to 2026-09-21).
Like for like, BXA TRx averaged 4,808 a week across 8 of 8 territories, up 8.4% against the comparison weeks.
Week over week, BXA TRx is 4,808 against 4,701 the week before (up 2.3%).
Against the comparison weeks, Great Lakes fell most (down 8.3%) and Southeast rose most (up 39%).
Chart: BXA TRx a week, 2026-07-06 to 2026-09-28: projected national. Hollow points are projected or estimated, an assumption (weeks of 2026-07-06). No forecast is drawn.
Projected national moved from 4,285 in the week of 2026-07-06 to 4,808 in the week of 2026-09-28.
By territory, all observed.
Great Lakes: 626 BXA TRx a week; down 14% on the week before; down 8.3% on the comparison weeks.
Mid-Atlantic: 706 BXA TRx a week; down 8.1% on the week before; up 0.5% on the comparison weeks.
Mountain: 407 BXA TRx a week; down 2.6% on the week before; up 9.2% on the comparison weeks.
New England: 477 BXA TRx a week; up 29% on the week before; up 27% on the comparison weeks.
Northwest: 389 BXA TRx a week; down 13% on the week before; down 7.8% on the comparison weeks.
Pacific: 821 BXA TRx a week; up 2.5% on the week before; up 11% on the comparison weeks.
South Central: 583 BXA TRx a week; up 5.8% on the week before; up 3.6% on the comparison weeks.
Southeast: 799 BXA TRx a week; up 30% on the week before; up 39% on the comparison weeks.
## What changed and why
Story one: Southeast. BXA TRx averaged 799 a week against 576 before (up 39%), while the other territories were up 3.9%.
By channel: Medicare Part D up 46%, Commercial up 44%; by specialty: Cardiology up 47%, Primary care up 42%.
Checked, in this order:
- Data artifact: ruled out. Every Southeast cut in these weeks passes the feed gate.
- Access: ruled out. No BXA access change in the Southeast plans in the tested months.
- Promotion: supported as recovery after the promotion lapse of 2026-08-03 to 2026-08-31, one-week lag. New patients (NBRx) in Southeast rose 46% and TRx rose 39% on the comparison weeks. Aggregated calls averaged 53 a week against 39 in the comparison weeks, each shifted one week earlier, which include lapse weeks (36% higher). Compared with territories without a promotion change, this implies 68 to 267 extra TRx a week. Re-check after 2026-10-26.
- Supply: ruled out. No tested lag lines up with TRx. BXA inventory fill averaged 0.99.
- Competitor launch: ruled out as a local cause. Before the change Metacora held 15% of the basket here against 14% elsewhere.
Confidence: Medium. Candidate drivers: promotion.

Promotion detail, read at the one-week lag (the period against the comparison weeks, aggregated activity, weekly averages):
- New patients (NBRx): 81.3 to 119.0 (up 46%).
- TRx: 576 to 799 (up 39%).
- Rep calls: 39 to 53 (up 36%).
- Digital impressions: 1,286 to 1,479 (up 15%).
- Samples: 26 to 36 (up 37%).
- Speaker programs: 1.3 to 1.0 (down 20%).
- Comparison: 5 other territories held their promotion level (no channel moved by 30% or more at this lag) and are the comparison. Each gives one implied effect: this territory's TRx a week in the period, less its TRx in the comparison weeks scaled by that territory's own change. The range, 68 to 267 extra TRx a week, runs from the lowest to the highest of them.
- Lags tested: same week, one-week lag and two-week lag. A fuller read is possible after 2026-10-26.
Story two: New England. BXA TRx averaged 477 a week against 376 before (up 27%), while the other territories were up 6.7%.
By channel: Medicare Part D up 32%, Medicaid up 31%; by specialty: Cardiology up 46%, Primary care up 18%, Endocrinology too small to quote.

- Data artifact: ruled out. Every New England cut in these weeks passes the feed gate.
- Access: ruled out. No BXA access change in the New England plans in the tested months.
- Promotion: ruled out. No tested lag lines up with TRx. New patients (NBRx) in New England rose 58% and TRx rose 27% on the comparison weeks. Aggregated calls averaged 28 a week against 30 in the comparison weeks. Samples moved, and TRx did not follow. Re-check after 2026-10-26.
- Supply: ruled out. No tested lag lines up with TRx. BXA inventory fill averaged 0.98.
- Competitor launch: ruled out as a local cause. Before the change Metacora held 14% of the basket here against 14% elsewhere.
Confidence: Low. Unresolved, investigate next. No driver is named.

P3-Q4.question: Week of 2026-09-28: Is this new or the same issue as last week, and is it getting better or worse?

P4-Q4.answer:
Brief for weeks 2025-11-03 to 2025-12-15. Product: BXA.
## Bottom line
Mid-Atlantic: BXA TRx is up 4.6% against the four weeks before (2025-10-06 to 2025-10-27).
Projected national BXA TRx averaged 5,366 a week from 2025-11-03 to 2025-12-15.
Like for like on 8 of 8 territories, BXA TRx is up 3.0% against the four weeks before (2025-10-06 to 2025-10-27).
BXA held 36% of the four-brand market basket.
Least sure: the Mid-Atlantic change (up 4.6%), within its normal range; reported because the question asks about it.
## The numbers
Scope: weeks 2025-11-03 to 2025-12-15, compared with the four weeks before (2025-10-06 to 2025-10-27).
Like for like, BXA TRx averaged 5,366 a week across 8 of 8 territories, up 3.0% against the comparison weeks.
Against the comparison weeks, Pacific fell most (down 5.0%) and Great Lakes rose most (up 9.7%).
Chart: BXA TRx a week, 2025-09-22 to 2025-12-15: projected national and Mid-Atlantic. No forecast is drawn.
Projected national moved from 5,044 in the week of 2025-09-22 to 5,370 in the week of 2025-12-15.
By territory, all observed.
Great Lakes: 791 BXA TRx a week; up 9.7% on the comparison weeks.
Mid-Atlantic: 815 BXA TRx a week; up 4.6% on the comparison weeks.
Mountain: 387 BXA TRx a week; down 2.2% on the comparison weeks.
New England: 494 BXA TRx a week; up 4.9% on the comparison weeks.
Northwest: 493 BXA TRx a week; up 5.7% on the comparison weeks.
Pacific: 857 BXA TRx a week; down 5.0% on the comparison weeks.
South Central: 733 BXA TRx a week; up 6.2% on the comparison weeks.
Southeast: 795 BXA TRx a week; up 1.5% on the comparison weeks.
## What changed and why
Story one: Mid-Atlantic. BXA TRx averaged 815 a week against 779 before (up 4.6%), while the other territories were up 2.7%. Mid-Atlantic moved within its normal range; it is reported because the question asks about it.
By channel: Medicare Part D up 9.6%, Cash up 5.5%; by specialty: Internal medicine up 22%, Cardiology down 7.3%.
Checked, in this order:
- Data artifact: ruled out. Every Mid-Atlantic cut in these weeks passes the feed gate.
- Access: supported. The Medicare Part D plan one (26% of the territory's covered lives) removed restrictions effective 2025-11-01. BXA volume on that plan rose 12%. The monthly source cannot distinguish a weekly lag.
- Promotion: not testable; activity held level, so its effect cannot be measured this period. All four channels stayed near their comparison-week levels at every tested lag. Re-check after 2026-01-12.
- Supply: ruled out. No tested lag lines up with TRx. BXA inventory fill averaged 0.98.
- Competitor launch: ruled out. Metacora did not launch until 2026-03-02.
Confidence: High. Leading driver: access.

with cuts as (
            select coalesce(plan_id, 'Unclassified') as cut,
                coalesce(sum(trx) filter (where week_start in (DATE '2025-11-03',DATE '2025-11-10',DATE '2025-11-17',DATE '2025-12-01',DATE '2025-12-08',DATE '2025-12-15')), 0) / 6.0 as recent,
                coalesce(sum(trx) filter (where week_start in (DATE '2025-10-06',DATE '2025-10-13',DATE '2025-10-20',DATE '2025-10-27')), 0) / 4.0 as baseline
            from reporting.v_reportable_rx
            where product_id = 'BXA' and territory_id = 'MID_ATLANTIC'
                and week_start in (DATE '2025-10-06',DATE '2025-10-13',DATE '2025-10-20',DATE '2025-10-27',DATE '2025-11-03',DATE '2025-11-10',DATE '2025-11-17',DATE '2025-12-01',DATE '2025-12-08',DATE '2025-12-15')
            group by 1
        ), ordered as (
            select *, recent - baseline as delta,
                row_number() over (order by abs(recent - baseline) desc, cut) as rank
            from cuts
        ), running as (
            select *, round(sum(delta) over (order by rank), 2) as cumulative
            from ordered
        ), contributions as (
            select *, cumulative - lag(cumulative, 1, 0) over (order by rank) as contribution
            from running
        )
    select abs(cumulative) from running order by rank desc limit 1

WIN-1.answer:
Brief for weeks 2025-12-22 to 2025-12-29. Product: BXA.
## Bottom line
Projected national BXA TRx averaged 4,249 a week from 2025-12-22 to 2025-12-29.
Like for like on 8 of 8 territories, BXA TRx is up 9.8% against the same weeks last year (2024-12-23, 2024-12-30).

Least sure: the like-for-like change, the only change this brief states.
## The numbers
Scope: weeks 2025-12-22 to 2025-12-29, compared with the same weeks last year (2024-12-23, 2024-12-30).
Like for like, BXA TRx averaged 4,249 a week across 8 of 8 territories, up 9.8% against the comparison weeks.
Against the comparison weeks, South Central fell most (down 2.7%) and New England rose most (up 20%).

## What changed and why

No story is opened for a calendar week. Expect a rebound in the next regular week.
## What the data can't tell us
Data health: 0 territory-weeks are withheld across these weeks. No cut is withheld.
Chart: Feed coverage by territory and week, 2025-10-06 to 2025-12-29. Every cell is an observed count.

## Appendix
Data version 47bcfd650564. Product: BXA (Cardiovela), synthetic data.
Assumptions:
- Comparison weeks: the same weeks last year (2024-12-23, 2024-12-30). Source: analyst's choice.
- Like for like: changes use only territories whose feed passed the gate in every week compared. Withheld cuts are left out of every change and story, and never read as zero demand. Holiday weeks are left out. Source: the feed gate.
- Drivers: the checks evaluate the same week and delays of one and two weeks. A supported timing requires activity to move with reportable TRx. Monthly access data cannot identify a weekly lag. Promotion: controls first, then comparable territories.
Method: like-for-like figures use only territories whose feed passed the gate in every week compared. The projected national divides each territory's observed TRx by its panel coverage, and estimates a territory that cannot be read from its recent share of national. Changes, stories and drivers use like-for-like cuts only.
Glossary:
- Like for like: a comparison that uses only territories whose feed passed its checks in every week compared.
- Projected national: national TRx built territory by territory, each territory's observed TRx divided by its panel coverage, summed.
- Withheld cut: a territory or week whose data failed its checks, so no story or driver is given for it.
